mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or rank correlation between FEDFUNDS trend and returns is below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day returns positive in 60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY) trigger aggressive Fed rate hikes that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY periods, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more cases, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of PAYEMS increase periods, or rank correlation between PAYEMS trend and returns is below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of INDPRO < 100.0 instances, or average return in triggered periods not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline of GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative returns: 20-day returns positive in 60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing market contraction (HOUST growth < 0% YoY) reduces consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In HOUST growth < 0% YoY periods, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more cases, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
